en: Black-and-white image of a grand suspension bridge crossing a wide river in a European city. The bridge has massive stone pylons and ornate steel towers topped with sculptural details. Pedestrians and a few carriages are visible on the roadway. On the far riverbank stands a dense row of historic multi‑story buildings with spires and domes; boats line the quayside. Trees and a landscaped park occupy the near foreground.
